title: Data migration
description: Reconcile the opening balances you imported (open installment contracts and opening cash) with your old records, sign them off and, before any collection, undo a wrong batch.
csvFailed: The CSV could not be downloaded.

signOff.title: Sign off against the old records
signOff.description: Enter the totals from the signed paper. The system compares them with what the batches imported; any difference is refused and nothing is saved.
signOff.nothing: There is no batch waiting for a sign-off.
signOff.help: The open debt is compared with what was left on the import day, not with what is left after collections.
signOff.amountInvalid: Enter an amount with at most two decimals.
signOff.noteRequired: Write a note of at least 3 characters.

reverse.title: Reverse this batch
reverse.description: {count} contracts will be closed through a write-off record and left out of the report. Only possible before any collection and before the sign-off.
reverse.reasonRequired: Write a reason of 3 to 300 characters.

errors.MIGRATION_TOTAL_MISMATCH: The {field} does not match. Paper: {expected}. System: {system}. Difference: {difference}. Nothing was saved.
errors.MIGRATION_SIGNED_OFF: This batch is already signed off.
errors.notReversible: This batch cannot be reversed: contract {number} has a {reason}.
errors.FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: This file type is not allowed.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the values and try again.
